Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a report on the employment status of basic health plan and medical assistance recipients.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the employment status of basic health plan andmedical assistance recipients; adding a new section to chapter 70.47RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.47 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The administrator, in coordination with the department ofsocial and health services, shall prepare an annual report on theemployment status of basic health plan enrollees under this chapter.The report shall detail the number of employees enrolled in the basichealth plan by employer, ranked from the employer with the highestnumber of employees on the basic health plan to the employer with thelowest number of employees on the basic health plan. (2) The report shall be delivered electronically to appropriatecommittees of the senate and house of representatives by November 15thof each year, beginning November 15, 2006.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of social and health services, in coordinationwith the health care authority, shall prepare an annual report on theemployment status of recipients of medical assistance under thischapter. The report shall detail the number of employees who arerecipients of medical assistance by employer, ranked from the employerwith the highest number of employees who are recipients to the employerwith the lowest number of employees who are recipients. (2) The report shall be delivered electronically to appropriatecommittees of the senate and house of representatives by November 15thof each year, beginning November 15, 2006.
